name: shotlist-monorepo
description: Break any short video down into a frame-accurate shot list and export it as a reusable Remotion template.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @shotlist/schema && npm run build -w @shotlist/template && npm run build -w shotlist
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck -w @shotlist/tutorial
scripts.sample:analyze: node cli/dist/index.js analyze samples/test-clip.mp4 --no-llm -o samples/test-clip.shotlist.json && node scripts/sync-example.mjs
scripts.sample:export: node cli/dist/index.js export samples/test-clip.shotlist.json -o examples/test-clip-template --name test-clip-template --force
